implementation_notes: A static library or header-only target both contexts link, containing the shared value types and rules. Keep types trivially copyable and compareable; enforce the joint change policy with a CODEOWNERS-style rule plus a CI job that builds both consumers.
idiom_name: shared static library target + joint CODEOWNERS/CI
pitfalls: Templates in the kernel forcing every consumer to recompile
The kernel gaining virtual interfaces it does not need
